description.text:
The vibrant purple shop is Badiani’s latest addition to Canary Wharf within Cabot Place and is the perfect destination for those craving a sweet treat, an Italian coffee or one of their signature creative specialities such as their gelato croissant.

Established in Florence, Italy, in 1932, Badiani has been perfecting the art of artisanal ice cream for nearly a century. Badiani Cabot Place not only features classic favourites like Buontalenti, La Dolcevita, and Dark Chocolate Sorbet but also introduces their exclusive Coppa Gelato— a unique Badiani take on the classic gelato sundae.

At Badiani Cabot Place, you can enjoy a diverse array of sweet treats including cups and cones of gelato or sorbet, pinguinos, gelato cakes as well as gelato croissants and gelato burgers and more.

Pair their range of pastries with one of our Italian coffees, or indulge in a freshly made crepe. With a comfortable seating area, their shop is the perfect place to relax and enjoy these delights.

Badiani was born in 1932 in a special city: Florence, which is an icon and heritage of beauty all over the world, craftsmanship and creative genius. The Brand draws strength from this legacy. Badiani is one of the most famous gelato producers in the world and first and foremost a gelato shop in which every taste is carefully studied by an Award-Winning creative genius: Paolo Pomposi.

From Florence to the world, to become the finest gelato brand inspiring people with the taste of freshly made artisan products.
